item.title: Weekend Forecast
item.description: Best surf: Capitola, Friday, October 23 at 1 PM — 9 alone / 10 with instructor, with a 2.1 ft face, 81 ft of runway, light offshore wind, and sunny 66°F air. Best jump: Skydive California, Saturday all day — the earliest of the two smoothest all-day choices, with wind no higher than 3 mph, gusts no higher than 9 mph, and dry conditions. All times PDT.
